Create a session through the API and print its id

Usage: mj new [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]

Arguments:
  [PROMPT]  The first prompt. `-` reads it from standard input

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>
          Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --profile <PROFILE>
          Profile the session runs its harness from. Omit it to use the saved default saved by an interactive launch. This command does not change it
      --no-splash
          Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
      --target <TARGET>
          Target template the session is provisioned on. Omit it to use the saved default, as for `--profile`, without changing it
      --bundle <BUNDLE>
          Existing bundle to run. Bare targets use `--project-directory` instead
      --project-directory <PROJECT_DIRECTORY>
          Existing directory on the bare target, or a checkout on the controller host for discovering an isolated project
      --at <SHA>
          Start the workspace checked out at this full commit ID in the bundle's primary repository
      --no-later-history
          With --at, give the workspace the full history up to that commit and --base, and nothing later: no later commits, branches, tags, or origin remote. --base must then be a full commit ID. The session cannot be resumed or moved
      --branch <BRANCH>
          With --at, the new branch to create there; otherwise the existing branch to check out
      --base <REV>
          Record this Git revision as the diff base, when it should not be --at
      --workspace-id <WORKSPACE_ID>
          Workspace id to create the session in. `--workspace NAME` names the same workspace by name
      --title <TITLE>
          Title shown in session lists. Defaults to the project and profile
      --model <MODEL>
          Load balance across usable profiles for this model and optional effort
      --effort <EFFORT>
          Harness reasoning effort to select before the first prompt
      --subagents <SUBAGENTS>
          Delegation policy: native, mjolnir, or none (no delegation tools). Defaults to mjolnir, with a notice when unavailable and native or none is used
      --oracle <ORACLE>
          Oracle availability for this session [possible values: enabled, disabled]
      --orchestrators
          Enable orchestrators (requires Mjolnir delegation)
      --subagent-straightforward <SUBAGENT_STRAIGHTFORWARD>
          Override the configured model for straightforward Mjolnir sub-agents
      --subagent-straightforward-effort <SUBAGENT_STRAIGHTFORWARD_EFFORT>
          Override straightforward sub-agent effort (requires --subagent-straightforward)
      --subagent-subtle <SUBAGENT_SUBTLE>
          Override the configured model for subtle Mjolnir sub-agents
      --subagent-subtle-effort <SUBAGENT_SUBTLE_EFFORT>
          Override subtle sub-agent effort (requires --subagent-subtle)
      --subagent-oracle <SUBAGENT_ORACLE>
          Oracle model for this session, independent of delegation
      --subagent-oracle-effort <SUBAGENT_ORACLE_EFFORT>
          Oracle effort; requires --subagent-oracle
      --reviewer <MODEL[:EFFORT]>
          Reviewer model and optional effort; final colon suffix is effort only when a known effort (minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max); trailing colon escapes it. Repeat up to three times
      --review <off|push>
          Whether this session is reviewed before push (`push`) or not (`off`). Omitted follows `[review]`: review runs when reviewers are configured
      --no-project-memory
          Start this session with no project memory: nothing from the workspace's project memory is loaded into the harness, and the harness is offered no memory directory to write to. Sub-agents of the session get none either. Without this flag the session loads the workspace's project memory
      --no-github-events
          Exclude this session from GitHub watcher delivery targets. Sub-agents inherit the choice
      --no-github-credentials
          Withhold GitHub credentials from this session and its children
      --ignore-notifications
          Ignore notifications for this session
      --cpus <CPUS>
          Container CPU limit. Omitted takes the target's default size: the size last chosen for that host, else 4 CPUs, capped at the host's
      --memory-gib <GIB>
          Container memory limit in GiB. Omitted takes the target's default size: the size last chosen for that host, else 8 GiB, capped at the host's
      --prompt-file <PROMPT_FILE>
          Read the first prompt from this file instead
      --json
          Print the response as JSON instead of text
      --workspace <NAME>
          Workspace to work in, by name. `mj new` and `mj acp` require it. `mj sessions` and `mj events` show only that workspace when it is given, and every workspace when it is not. `mj import`, and `mj resume --wiki` when it imports another tool's session, put the session in it, and need it when the instance has more than one workspace
  -h, --help
          Print help
